correctness.rationale: Each unit observation projector has isotropic half-trace and doubled-angle anisotropy s_t ζ^(−t), where ζ=exp(iπ/N). Thus the information eigenvalues are (N±|P_s(ζ)|)/(2σ²). At fixed trace the lower eigenvalue and determinant are maximized at zero anisotropy, while the trace of the positive-isotropic-prior posterior covariance is minimized there. Direct telescoping gives (1−ζ)P_s(ζ)=s_0+s_(N−1)+2Σ_switch s_t ζ^t, using ζ^N=−1. At a zero this gives k+1 roots for even k and k for odd k; the distinct exponents modulo N prohibit antipodes after absorbing each sign. Lam–Leung's prime-polygon classification and asymmetric support lower bound imply no such nonempty relation for power-of-two N, and otherwise at least p terms with equality only for a rotated p-gon. Independently, this short-relation lemma follows by residue splitting at repeated prime factors (the corresponding cyclotomic extension has degree that prime). At square-free even order, splitting over the largest odd prime q makes its coefficient sums all equal by the q-th cyclotomic polynomial over the coprime-order subfield. If q>p, an empty class forces all the sums to vanish and one reduces the order; with only 2 and p left, each nonempty class contains roots with the same sign, so ≤p terms require one per class, all of the same sign. Order two alone permits no nonzero antipode-free relation. Consequently k≥p−1. Equality requires a p-gon containing s_0; modulo N its nonzero locations are M,2M,…,(p−1)M with M=N/p. These switches force alternating equal blocks, and the block factor Σ_j(−ζ^M)^j indeed vanishes. For N=2^a p^b this same alternating block polynomial is monic of degree φ(2N) and vanishes at ζ, hence equals Φ_(2N). Divisibility and the nonoverlap of its p shifted quotient blocks force and suffice for an arbitrary ±1 first block of length M, giving exactly 2^M schedules.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The classical lemma is sufficient for the short root-sum statement and the one-odd-prime factorization is elementary. The least-switch rigidity result additionally ties root weights to noncyclic switches, excludes antipodes from the distinct switch positions, and uses equality plus an attainable block construction; these do not follow from imposing a support diameter or citing a general scheduling solver.

value.rationale: The switch budget is a natural extra constraint on attaining the best information matrix. The theorem provides a sharp, all-horizon prime-factor rule and a rigidity result that identifies the only least-switch realizations. The separate exact family census shows that uniqueness at the switch optimum need not imply uniqueness of isotropy. This gives structural information not supplied by a numerical optimum or an optimization formulation.
residual_risks: The conclusions use the tuned angle, equal independent noise, no process noise, one of two coordinate sensors per observation, and the noncyclic switch count. They do not optimize anisotropic schedules for power-of-two horizons or establish robustness to changing the angle.
